events.title: Post Card Friday
events.description: POSTCARDS ARE BACK THIS OCTOBER! 💌 We’re keeping the momentum going! Join the Oakland County Democratic Party at HQ for our October Postcard Writing Parties as we write, connect, and reach Michigan voters ahead of Election Day. 📅 October 9, 23 & 30 ⏰ 1:00–4:00 PM 📍 OCDP Headquarters 17100 W. 12 Mile Road, Suite 5 Southfield, MI 48076 Come for an hour or stay for the afternoon! We’ll have postcards, games, food, music, and good company while we get to work. No experience necessary — just bring yourself and a friend. 💙 🗳️ Every postcard is another opportunity to connect with a Michigan voter. Let’s write. Let’s connect. Let’s get out the vote!

events.title: OCDP Post Card Writing Party
events.description: Join the Oakland County Democratic Party for Postcard Fridays! We’ll come together to write postcards to Michigan voters, help get out the vote, and have some fun while we do it. Food, games, postcard supplies, and good company will be provided. Come for the entire afternoon or stop by when you can!

events.title: Michigan Democratic Women's Caucus Wayne Co. GOTV Rally
events.description: Join us for the MDWC's Wayne County Get Out the Vote Rally - bringing together special guests, music, and community leaders to motivate & inspire. Special guests U.S. Senator Mark Kelly and former Congresswoman Gabby Giffords will be part of the program, alongside music and other activities throughout the afternoon. Come connect with fellow community members, hear from our special guests, and get energized for the final stretch of election season. Light food and refreshments will be provided. Contact midemwomenscaucus@gmail.com with any questions.

events.title: Power in The Precinct; The MI Precinct Delegate & Grassroots Assembly!!
events.description: POWER IN THE PRECINCT The Michigan Precinct Delegates & Grassroots Assembly Get ready for a high-energy, action-packed statewide gathering bringing together Precinct Delegates and Grassroots Leaders from across Michigan! This Assembly is designed to train, connect, educate, and prepare you to organize in your precinct and community. 🔥 WHAT TO EXPECT: 🎤 SUPERSTAR GUEST SPEAKERS Hear from special guests and movement leaders who are doing the work and shaping the future of Michigan. 🗳️ INTENSIVE PRECINCT DELEGATE TRAINING Learn what it means to be a Precinct Delegate, what is expected of you, how to organize your precinct, build relationships with voters, and turn your position into grassroots power. 📣 PROP 1 & MOP BALLOT INITIATIVES Hear directly from special guests about Proposal 1 and MOP ballot initiatives, what they mean, and how grassroots leaders can educate and engage their communities. 🤝 GRASSROOTS CONNECTION & NETWORKING Connect with Precinct Delegates, organizers, activists, and grassroots leaders from across Michigan. 💪 STRATEGY + ACTION This isn't just a gathering to listen. We're coming together to learn, strategize, organize, and leave ready to take action. ALL PRECINCT DELEGATES & GRASSROOTS LEADERS ARE INVITED TO CONVENE. 📅 Saturday, October 24th 🕛 12 PM – 5 PM 📍 Westside Detroit Area

events.title: MDP Coalition Rally
events.description: The goal of this election rally is to bring together a strong coalition of communities and organizations to celebrate our strength, unity, and shared commitment as we move toward the November election. We will build momentum at the rally and carry that momentum all the way to the victory celebration in November. Invited guests include: the Governor, candidates for Governor, Lieutenant Governor, Secretary of State, Attorney General, U.S. Senate and Congressional candidates, candidates for the Michigan Supreme Court, State House and State Senate candidates, candidates for the Michigan State Board of Education and University Boards, as well as Michigan Democratic Party, Democratic Club, Caucus, and community leaders. For information, contact: Dr. Naz Hassan 2nd Vice Chair, MDP 734-262-1323
